question: Will the president of Russia sign by 31.12.2026 a decree announcing mobilisation (general or partial)?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 a decree of the president of the Russian Federation announcing mobilisation (the term "mobilisation" in the title or operative part) under the law on mobilisation preparation and mobilisation is published on publication.pravo.gov.ru or kremlin.ru. Decrees on conscription (including no. 998 of 29.12.2025), on exercises and special reserve formations, or on contract service do not count.
key_indicator: manpower needs per ISW; acts on the reserve; statements of the Russian MoD
notes: Panel. From P-006 — narrowed to a mobilisation decree (conscription in 2026 is year-round, a separate autumn decree is not expected).

question: Will at least one person be killed on the territory of a NATO state by a Russian drone or missile strike by 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if the government of a NATO state confirms that after 23.09.2026 at least one person was killed on its territory (land, territorial waters, airspace) by a drone or missile launched by Russia, including one that strayed or was shot down over that territory. Attribution to Russia — in the government statement.
key_indicator: drone and missile incidents in PL, RO, LT, LV, EE
notes: Panel. From P-013; who_benefits changed from RUSSIA to NONE (§3.6 — doubt).

question: Will the Pentagon or the White House announce by 31.03.2027 a decision to reduce the number of US troops in Europe by at least 10,000?
resolution_criterion: YES if an official statement (defense.gov, whitehouse.gov, eucom.mil) published after 23.09.2026 announces a decision (not an option or a leak) to reduce US troop strength in Europe by at least 10,000 soldiers net, in total across one or more announcements after 23.09.2026. Moves within Europe do not reduce strength. Reductions announced before 23.09.2026 do not count.
key_indicator: force posture review recommendation (by 06.11.2026); §1249 NDAA
notes: Panel. Replaces P-018 (criterion of reducing the rotational presence in Poland was ambiguous). who_benefits RUSSIA: a reduction of US forces in Europe strengthens Russia's position vis-à-vis NATO.

question: Will the net gain of Ukrainian territory occupied by Russia in October 2026 exceed 200 km² according to DeepState?
resolution_criterion: YES if the DeepState monthly summary for X 2026 shows a net gain (occupied minus recaptured) above 200 km². If DeepState gives only a gross value — use it. Secondary sources citing DeepState (ISW, Russia Matters, news agencies) are acceptable.
key_indicator: DeepState pace km²/week; Kramatorsk and Lyman axes
notes: Panel. New (K9 from G1). State: approx. 150 km² net in 4 weeks to 14.09 (G1-044). Resolution after publication of the DeepState summary (early XI).

question: Will the PRC Eastern Theater Command announce named military exercises around Taiwan by 31.03.2027?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the PLA Eastern Theater Command or the PRC Ministry of National Defense announces exercises with a proper name covering the area around Taiwan. Unnamed combat-readiness patrols do not count.
resolution_source: eng.chinamil.com.cn; mod.gov.cn; Xinhua; Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense
key_indicator: decision on the arms package for Taiwan; daily PLA activity per Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense
notes: Panel. From P-027 — deadline extended; who_benefits CHINA changed to NONE (§3.6).

question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract on 06.10.2026 exceed 100.00 USD/bbl?
resolution_criterion: YES if the settlement (closing) price of the nearest-month ICE Brent contract on 06.10.2026 > 100.00 USD/bbl. Sources: ICE settlement report or Reuters, CNBC, Trading Economics; in case of discrepancy ICE decides.
key_indicator: US–Iran talks; transits through Hormuz; OPEC+ 04.10
notes: Panel (rolling: after resolution replace with an analogous question dated to the next edition). State: 99.25 USD (22.09, G2-002). Futures contract instead of EIA RBRTE, because spot Dated Brent deviates from futures by more than ten USD (IEA: 113.48 USD on 09.09). | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved YES (2026-10-06); VERIFY pending user approval.

question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract exceed 120 USD/bbl on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement (closing) price of nearest-month ICE Brent > 120.00 USD/bbl. Sources: ICE or Reuters, CNBC, Trading Economics; in case of discrepancy ICE decides.
key_indicator: attacks on Yanbu and the East–West pipeline; breakdown of US–Iran talks
notes: Panel. From P-010 — source changed to the ICE contract (consistency with Q-0006).

question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract fall below 80 USD/bbl on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement (closing) price of nearest-month ICE Brent < 80.00 USD/bbl. Sources: ICE or Reuters, CNBC, Trading Economics; in case of discrepancy ICE decides.
key_indicator: US–Iran agreement; transits through Hormuz
notes: Panel. From P-011 — source changed to the ICE contract.

question: Will the settlement price of the TTF front-month contract exceed 90 EUR/MWh on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement price of nearest-month ICE Endex TTF > 90.00 EUR/MWh. Sources: ICE Endex or Trading Economics, Reuters; in case of discrepancy ICE Endex decides.
key_indicator: EU storage; Qatari force majeure; weather; Norwegian supplies
notes: Panel. From P-009 — threshold lowered from 100 to 90 EUR/MWh (September peak approx. 84; state on 22.09: 71–74).

question: Will EU gas storage fill per GIE AGSI+ on gas day 01.01.2027 be below 55.0%?
resolution_criterion: YES if the EU storage fill value (EU, % of capacity) in AGSI+ for gas day 01.01.2027 < 55.0. The first publication for that day counts.
key_indicator: injection and withdrawal rate; weather XI–XII; Qatar
notes: Panel. From P-008 — threshold raised from 45% to 55% so that the question is not trivial given a projection of approx. 78% on 01.11 (G2-018). State: 70.3% (22.09).

question: Will the governments of the USA and the PRC both announce by 10.11.2026 an extension of the trade (tariff) truce or a new trade agreement replacing it?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 and no later than 10.11.2026 official sources of both governments (White House, USTR or Treasury, and MOFCOM or Xinhua quoting the PRC government) announce an extension of the truce expiring on 10.11.2026 for any period, or a trade agreement replacing it. An announcement suffices; implementing acts may follow later.
key_indicator: statements after the 24.09 summit; US–PRC Board of Trade
notes: Panel. Merged P-028 and K3-03; deadline shortened to the truce expiry date. | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved YES (2026-09-28); VERIFY pending user approval.

question: Will the US president impose a tariff under H.R. 5334 on goods from at least one country other than Russia by 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 a proclamation, executive order or Federal Register notice is published imposing a tariff on goods from a country other than Russia with reference to H.R. 5334 (Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026), with an effective date no later than 31.12.2026. An announcement without an act does not count.
key_indicator: 30-day deadline (approx. 18.10.2026); reactions of India, Turkey and the PRC
notes: Panel. New (K3-01, deadline extended). State: authorisation, tariffs not imposed (G3-003).

question: Will the Statistics Poland (GUS) flash estimate of CPI inflation for September 2026 be at least 3.5% y/y?
resolution_criterion: YES if the flash estimate of the consumer price index for IX 2026 published by GUS is at least 3.5% y/y. The first publication (flash estimate) counts, not a revision.
key_indicator: fuel prices after the return of 23% VAT from 01.09; food prices
notes: Panel (rolling). State: CPI VIII 3.4% (G3-027). Deadline = scheduled date of the flash estimate; if moved, the first publication decides. | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved YES (2026-09-30).

question: Will the FAO Food Price Index (FFPI) for September 2026 be higher than 133.3 points?
resolution_criterion: YES if the first publication of the FAO Food Price Index for IX 2026 gives a value higher than 133.3 (the value for VIII from the 05.09.2026 publication). A possible revision of the VIII value does not change the threshold.
key_indicator: grain and sugar prices; fertilisers; Black Sea exports
notes: Panel (rolling). New (K-G2-14). Indicative deadline; the first publication for IX decides. | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved YES (2026-10-02); VERIFY pending user approval.

question: Will the USA introduce a tariff on EU goods exceeding the 15% ceiling set in the 2026 agreement by 31.03.2027?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the US government publishes an act (proclamation, executive order, USTR notice in the Federal Register) raising the combined tariff rate above 15% on EU goods covered by the "all-inclusive" ceiling, with an effective date no later than 31.03.2027. Not counted: section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminium, categories excluded from the ceiling as of 23.09.2026, and anti-dumping and countervailing duties.
key_indicator: US–EU trade disputes; legal basis of US tariffs after expiry of s.122
notes: Panel. New (no ECO questions on US–EU relations among the proposals from 00). State: 15% ceiling since 01.07.2026 (G3-043).

question: Will the Monetary Policy Council change the NBP reference rate at any meeting between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if the MPC statement after a meeting in this period changes the reference rate (in either direction).
key_indicator: CPI (flash estimate for IX on 30.09); NBP projection XI; ECB and Fed decisions
notes: Panel. From P-015. State: 3.75% since III 2026; meetings 07.10, 04.11, XII.

question: Will the ECB raise the deposit rate at a meeting held between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after a meeting of the ECB Governing Council in this period (29.10 or XII) the deposit rate is higher than 2.50%.
key_indicator: HICP; energy prices; pricing of rate contracts
notes: Panel. From P-016 — reworded: the hike of 10.09.2026 happened before the creation date.

question: Will OFAC add to the SDN list by 31.03.2027 a bank registered in mainland PRC in connection with Iran or Russia?
resolution_criterion: YES if an OFAC notice (Recent Actions) after 23.09.2026 adds to the SDN list a bank (an institution with a banking licence) registered in the PRC outside Hong Kong and Macao, with a justification relating to Iran or Russia. Branches of foreign banks in the PRC and non-bank institutions do not count.
key_indicator: Operation Economic Outcast; H.R. 5334; outcome of the 24.09 summit
notes: Panel. From P-002 — the "majority state ownership" criterion replaced by registration in the PRC (verifiable), extended to Russia; deadline extended; who_benefits US_WEST changed to NONE (§3.6).

question: Will the EU Council adopt the 22nd package of sanctions against Russia by 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the EU Council announces the formal adoption of a package of sanctions against Russia named in the Council statement as the 22nd package.
key_indicator: Commission proposal; work of the RELEX working party; positions of FR, SK, HU
notes: Panel. From P-023. State: no formal Commission proposal; package "not earlier than end of X" (G3-039).

question: Will the Bank of Russia cut its key rate at the meeting scheduled for 23.10.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after the Bank of Russia board meeting on 23.10.2026 (or a rescheduled one, no later than 31.10.2026) the key rate is lower than 14.00%.

notes: Panel. New (K3-06). State: 14.00% — pause on 11.09 after 10 cuts (G3-021).

question: Will the PRC announce by 10.11.2026 an extension or repeal of the suspension of the rare-earth export controls introduced on 09.10.2025?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 and no later than 10.11.2026 MOFCOM or GAC (or Xinhua quoting MOFCOM) announces an extension of the suspension of the controls of 09.10.2025 (MOFCOM announcements of 2025 nos. 55–58, 61, 62) for any period, or their permanent repeal. An extension of some of the announcements counts if it covers rare-earth controls.

notes: Panel. Merged P-001 and K-G2-06. | Edition 02 stage 01: MOFCOM 28.09.2026 confirmed the Kuala Lumpur arrangement extended to 10.01.2027 without naming the rare-earth announcements; no MOFCOM/GAC announcement extending the suspension of nos. 55-58, 61, 62 found by 07.10 - left ACTIVE.

question: Will the PRC announce by 27.11.2026 an extension or repeal of the suspension of the ban on exports of gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard materials to the USA?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 and no later than 27.11.2026 MOFCOM announces an extension of the suspension of this ban for any period or its permanent repeal.
key_indicator: outcome of the 24.09 summit; rare-earth decision before 10.11
notes: Panel. New (K-G2-07). State: suspension until 27.11.2026 (G2-034).

question: Will MOFCOM add at least one US entity to the export control list or the unreliable entity list between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if a MOFCOM announcement published in this period contains a new listing of a US entity on the export control list (出口管制管控名单) or the unreliable entity list.
key_indicator: PRC reaction to H.R. 5334 and arms sales to Taiwan
notes: Panel. New (K3-14). State: last listing 22.06.2026 (G3-047).

question: Will the US government permit exports to the PRC of Nvidia AI chips with the Blackwell architecture or newer by 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the Department of Commerce (BIS) or the White House announces permission (a rule, licences or a licensing policy) for exports to the PRC of at least one Nvidia chip with the Blackwell architecture or newer (including a reduced-performance version), or Nvidia officially confirms receiving such permission.
key_indicator: outcome of the 24.09 summit; AI Overwatch Act in Congress
notes: Panel. New. State: Blackwell subject to the ban, H200 permitted (G2-038). who_benefits CHINA: access to the newest chips strengthens PRC AI capabilities at the expense of the US advantage.

question: Will PRC exports of rare-earth permanent magnets to the USA in September 2026 exceed 512 t?
resolution_criterion: YES if the first publication of PRC General Administration of Customs data for IX 2026 shows exports of rare-earth permanent magnets to the USA above 512 t (the value for VIII). Secondary sources citing GAC (SMM, Reuters, Bloomberg) are acceptable.
key_indicator: MOFCOM decisions; outcome of the 24.09 summit
notes: Panel (rolling). New. State: VIII 512 t, −21% m/m (G2-035). Deadline = indicative GAC publication date.

question: Will a trilateral meeting of government delegations of the USA, Ukraine and Russia take place by 30.11.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 at least two of the three parties (the Kremlin, the Office of the President of Ukraine, the White House or State Department) officially confirm a meeting of government delegations of all three states in one place, at any level.
key_indicator: statements by Ushakov and Peskov; offers from hosts (Abu Dhabi, Turkey)
notes: Panel. From P-005; who_benefits COMPROMISE changed to NONE (a meeting is not an agreement).

question: Will any NATO state submit a request for consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if NATO or the government of a member state confirms that a request for consultations under Article 4 was submitted in this period.
key_indicator: incidents on the flank (drones, missiles, the Baltic)
notes: Panel. From P-014. State: no request in 2026 (G1-041).

question: Will the USA and Iran announce by 31.12.2026 the conclusion of an agreement (framework, interim or final) that includes the opening of the Strait of Hormuz?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 official sources of both governments (White House or State Department, and the president or Foreign Ministry of Iran) confirm the conclusion of an agreement, including a memorandum or interim agreement, whose announced content includes opening or restoring shipping through Hormuz. Declarations of readiness and frameworks for further talks without an agreed text do not count.
key_indicator: date of the second round of talks; Iran's conditions (blockade, assets, Yemen)
notes: Panel. Replaces P-004 (a round of talks was confirmed by both sides on 22.09 — before the creation date).

question: Will Donald Trump personally attend the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen (18–19.11.2026)?
resolution_criterion: YES if Trump is physically present at the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen, as confirmed by the White House or at least two news agencies. Remote participation or a delegation without the president — NO. If the leaders' meeting does not take place by 30.11.2026 — NO.
key_indicator: outcome of the 24.09 summit; announcement of "reciprocal visits within half a year"
notes: Panel. From P-021; who_benefits COMPROMISE changed to NONE (§3.6).

question: Will Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump meet in person by 31.03.2027?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 Putin and Trump meet in person, as confirmed by the Kremlin and the White House.
key_indicator: progress of trilateral talks; Rubio–Lavrov talks
notes: Panel. New (K4-05, deadline extended).

question: Will the Republican Party win at least 218 seats in the House of Representatives in the 03.11.2026 elections?
resolution_criterion: YES if according to AP race calls or results certified by the Clerk of the House Republicans win at least 218 seats. If by 31.12.2026 no party has 218 called seats — resolve on the day AP announces control of the House.
key_indicator: generic ballot polling average; presidential approval
notes: Panel. From P-017. p_status_quo 0.90: YES = the current majority is retained. State: generic ballot D +7–8 (G4-035).

question: Will a new video or audio recording of Mojtaba Khamenei speaking be published by 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 official Iranian media (IRIB, khamenei.ir, leader.ir) publish a video or audio recording of him speaking or appearing in public, and at least two independent international media consider it new and authentic. Written statements, photos and archive recordings do not count.
key_indicator: statements of the Supreme Leader's office
notes: Panel. Merged P-020 and K4-15. State: only written statements since 09.03.2026 (G4-012).

question: Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win the 2026 presidential election in Brazil (first round 04.10 or second round 25.10)?
resolution_criterion: YES if the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) declares Lula the winner of the 2026 presidential election in the first or second round.
key_indicator: Datafolha and Quaest polls; first-round result
notes: Panel. New (K4-08). p_status_quo 0.90: YES = the incumbent president keeps office. State: second round Lula 46 vs F. Bolsonaro 44 (G4-033).

question: Will the CNE or the government of Venezuela announce a specific date for the presidential election by 31.03.2027?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the CNE or the government of Venezuela publishes a schedule with a specific voting day for the presidential election.
key_indicator: replacement of the TSJ and CNE; US position
notes: Panel. From P-024 — deadline extended (replacement of the TSJ since 18.09, CNE in progress — G4-041, G4-042).

question: Will Assimi Goïta cease to hold power in Mali by 31.03.2027 (coup, resignation, death or capture of Bamako by JNIM or the FLA)?
resolution_criterion: YES if at least two independent international media confirm that after 23.09.2026 Goïta ceased to serve as transitional president or lost de facto control over Bamako.
resolution_source: news agencies (AFP, Reuters, AP); Al Jazeera; ACLED
key_indicator: fuel blockade of Bamako; JNIM attacks in central Mali
notes: Panel. From P-025 — deadline extended; the junta leader named.

resolution_criterion: YES if IMF PortWatch data (transit calls, Strait of Hormuz) show a 7-day average above 40 for any day in this period.
key_indicator: daily PortWatch transits; US–Iran talks; blockade
notes: Panel. From P-003; who_benefits COMPROMISE changed to NONE. PortWatch relies on AIS and may not record escorted traffic without transponders (contradiction G1-001 vs G2-006) — the criterion remains PortWatch.

question: Will IMF PortWatch record at least 20 transits through the Strait of Hormuz on any day between 24.09 and 07.10.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if the daily number of transits (transit calls) in IMF PortWatch data for the Strait of Hormuz is at least 20 on any day in this period.
key_indicator: US–Iran talks; offer to open within 7 days
notes: Panel (rolling). New (K1 from G1). State: 1 transit on 20.09 (G1-001). PortWatch data are about a week behind — resolution after publication. AIS caveat as in Q-0036. | Edition 02 stage 01: not resolved - PortWatch daily data published to 04.10 only (max 5 transits/day 24.09-04.10); resolve after 05-07.10 are published.

question: Will the USA officially lift or suspend the naval blockade of Iranian ports by 31.12.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the White House, the Pentagon or CENTCOM announces the lifting or suspension (including temporary) of the blockade of Iranian ports as a whole.
key_indicator: US–Iran talks; Iran's condition no. 1 (G4-003)
notes: Panel. New (K3 from G1). State: blockade since 14.07; 109 ships turned back by 20.09 (G1-006).

question: Will the Panama Canal Authority raise the daily transit limit above 32 by 31.10.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if an ACP statement (advisory to shipping) announces a limit higher than 32 transits per day, in force on any day by 31.10.2026.
key_indicator: Gatún Lake level; rainfall
notes: Panel. New (K13 from G1). State: 32/day since 15.09 (G1-058). | Edition 02 stage 01: ACP advisory of 28.09.2026 announces 33 daily slots from 15.10.2026; resolve once in force (not resolved before the state date).

question: Will the government or prosecutor of a Baltic Sea state announce by 31.03.2027 damage to a subsea cable or pipeline in the Baltic together with proceedings concerning external action?
resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the government or prosecutor of PL, DE, DK, SE, FI, EE, LV or LT announces damage to a subsea cable (power or telecommunications) or pipeline in the Baltic Sea and the opening of an investigation or the detention of a ship on suspicion of external action (sabotage, dragged anchor). Technical failures without such proceedings do not count.
resolution_source: statements of governments and prosecutors of Baltic Sea states; Reuters
key_indicator: shadow fleet movements; anchor incidents; NATO patrols
notes: Panel. New (INF gap from 00: cable incidents in 2026 not collected).

question: Will CENTCOM or the Pentagon announce a US strike on a target on Iranian land territory between 24.09 and 07.10.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if an official statement by CENTCOM, the Pentagon or the White House confirms a US strike (air, missile, drone) on a target on land in Iran carried out in this period. Strikes on vessels and in Yemen or Iraq do not count.
resolution_source: centcom.mil; defense.gov; Reuters/AP as second source
key_indicator: CENTCOM statements; breakdown of talks
notes: Open. New (K2 from G1). State: 15 periods without strikes (G1-005). | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved NO (2026-10-07); VERIFY pending user approval.

question: Will another round of talks between representatives of the US and Iranian governments (direct or indirect) take place between 24.09 and 07.10.2026?
resolution_criterion: YES if at least two independent sources, including a statement by one of the parties or a mediator (Qatar, Pakistan, Oman), confirm a meeting of US and Iranian government delegations starting on 24.09.2026 or later, in one place — directly or with a mediator shuttling between delegations. notes: Open. New (K4-01). Replaces P-004 in the short horizon. | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved NO (2026-10-07); VERIFY pending user approval.

notes: Open. New (K4 from G1). State: attack on 19.09 (G1-015), 21–22.09 no confirmed launch (G1-019). | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved YES (2026-09-26).

notes: Open. New (K6 from G1). Replaces P-019 (the criterion of arrival of additional soldiers is unverifiable — no public record of troop strength). | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved NO (2026-10-07).

resolution_criterion: YES if a statement of DO RSZ or the Ministry of National Defence confirms the entry of a drone, missile or aircraft from the direction of Russia or Belarus into Polish airspace in this period. Smuggling balloons and interceptions over international waters do not count.

notes: Open. New. State: on 22.09 interception of an Il-20 over international waters (G1-033) — no violation of Polish airspace. | Edition 02 stage 01: resolved NO (2026-10-07).
